title: An Army Laughed at One Kitten Knight | Legend of The Knight Cat Ep 1
description:
The garrison has gone. The gate will not close. Three thousand soldiers are on the south road - and the only thing left standing in it is a knee-high knight in a white cape.

THE LAST VIGIL is an original dark-fantasy series. Dame Wren is the last of the Vigil, the old Queen's gate-wardens, sworn to hold her post until the crown tells her to stop. The Queen has been dead two winters. Nobody told the oath.

Episode 1 - The Low Gate. Episode 2 is on the way.

This is a work of fiction. All characters, places and events are invented. Made with AI-assisted image and video tools; the story, the characters and the world are our own.

#fantasy #dragon #knightcat #darkfantasy #shortfilm
